Missing teeth can affect your smile, confidence, and ability to chew comfortably. While dental implants are a popular tooth replacement option, they may not be suitable for everyone due to medical conditions, insufficient jawbone, or budget considerations. In such cases, precision attachments offer a reliable, comfortable, and aesthetic alternative.
